## 下载 / Download

Windows、macOS 和 Linux 均提供 amd64 / arm64 程序包。下载下面的程序包即可，无需 Go、源码或整个 docs 目录。页面、海报和 Token 计数器已内嵌；模型 API 由你自己提供。

Portable packages for Windows, macOS and Linux, with amd64 / arm64 builds. No Go installation or source checkout is needed. The UI, artwork and token counter are embedded. Bring your own model API.

| 系统 / System | 文件后缀 / Package suffix |
| --- | --- |
| 普通 Windows 电脑 / Intel or AMD PC | `windows_amd64.zip` |
| Windows ARM | `windows_arm64.zip` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `macos_arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Intel | `macos_amd64.tar.gz` |
| Linux x86-64 / ARM64 | `linux_amd64.tar.gz` / `linux_arm64.tar.gz` |

Windows：解压后双击 `babel.exe`，使用期间保持控制台窗口打开。macOS/Linux：在解压目录打开终端，运行 `./babel`。浏览器未自动打开时，访问终端打印的本机地址。

Windows: extract and double-click `babel.exe`; keep its console open. macOS/Linux: run `./babel` from a terminal in the extracted folder. If your browser does not open, use the local URL printed in the terminal.

每个包只含程序、许可证、第三方许可说明和 `START_HERE.txt`。下载完整性可对照 `SHA256SUMS`；程序目前未签名或公证。GitHub 自动附带的 **Source code** 是源码，不是可运行程序。

Each package contains the executable, license notices and `START_HERE.txt`. Use `SHA256SUMS` to check download integrity. Binaries are currently unsigned and not notarized. GitHub's **Source code** downloads are for developers.

[English guide](https://github.com/XavierJu007/Babel-Compiler#quick-start) · [中文说明](https://github.com/XavierJu007/Babel-Compiler/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)
